# Cooper Crane LLC

> Certified-operator crane and boom truck service across Southeast Florida: Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade counties, West Palm Beach to South Miami. Fleet runs from a 2-ton mini spider crane (fits through a 36-inch gate) to a 40-ton mobile crane, with 17-ton and 35-ton boom trucks in between. Every lift includes a certified Cooper Crane operator who handles rigging and signaling.

## Key facts
- Phone: (954) 445-6186
- Email: Coopercranefl@gmail.com
- Base: West Park, Broward County, FL
- Service area: Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade counties
- Common lifts: rooftop AC units, pest-control fumigation tarps, roof and floor trusses, roofing material, generators, plus one-off lifts (trees, steel, signage, hot tubs)
- Payment: QuickBooks invoicing; credit card, Cash App and Zelle
- Reviews: 4.0 stars across 20 Google reviews
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CooperCraneFL
